# Synthetic OpenSky fixtures

These are **not** OpenSky data. They are hand-written to follow the documented response
schema (https://openskynetwork.github.io/opensky-api/rest.html), with made-up `icao24`
addresses (`f0f0xx`) and callsigns (`TEST...`). OpenSky's terms forbid passing their
data on and ask for anonymised aircraft identifiers in anything disclosed, so no real
response is stored in this repo.
